Wow, I’m really disappointed in @Apple’s Siri in iOS 27. It reminds me of 2012, when we would talk about how Apple is just years behind everyone else. They wait 5 years after everyone else already has something and then present it as new.

Same thing here. After I highlight something and click the Siri button, it invites me to ask a question about the thing. Then it has no idea what I’m talking about. But that’s not the biggest issue. There’s no prompt engineering at all. I think it’s running GPT-3.5 Turbo. These are the kind of crappy answers that could be generated on-device,

with maybe a quick google search to improve answer relevance, so I can understand the server-side processing due to the larger prefill due to the search.

items.title: 🤖 GPT-2’den GPT-6’ya Yapay Zekanın Evrimi: Cümle Tamamlamadan "Otonom İş Ortaklığına" Büyük Dönüşüm! 👇
items.summary:
🤖 GPT-2’den GPT-6’ya Yapay Zekanın Evrimi: Cümle Tamamlamadan "Otonom İş Ortaklığına" Büyük Dönüşüm! 👇
Birçoğumuz ChatGPT’yi günlük işler için kullanıyoruz ama arka planda dönen milyarlarca dolarlık teknolojik savaştan ve mimari değişimden haberdar değiliz. Paylaştığım infografik, yapay zekanın sadece 7 yılda nasıl "insan beyni" hızına ulaştığını net bir şekilde özetliyor.
İşte teknoloji tarihine yön veren o büyük kırılma noktaları:
🧠 2019 - GPT-2 (Sıfır Örnekli / Zero-Shot)
Her şey 1.5 Milyar parametreyle başladı. GPT-2’ye bir metin veriyordunuz ve o sadece istatistiksel olarak bir sonraki kelimeyi tahmin ediyordu. Henüz ortada bir "asistan" yoktu, sadece gelişmiş bir metin tamamlayıcı vardı.
🚀 2020 - GPT-3 (Az Örnekli / Few-Shot)
Parametre sayısı tam 175 Milyar'a fırladı! "Bağlam içi öğrenme" (In-context learning) hayatımıza girdi. Sisteme birkaç örnek verdiğinizde ne yapmak istediğinizi anlayıp harika çıktılar vermeye başladı. Yapay zekanın asıl miladı buydu.
👁️ 2023 - GPT-4 (Çok Modlu / Multimodal)
Sadece metin değil; fotoğrafları, grafikleri ve dökümanları da anlamaya başladı. RLHF (İnsan Geri Bildirimli İnce Ayar) ile sisteme "insani mantık" aşılandı. 8K-32K bağlam penceresiyle devasa dosyaları tek seferde okuyabilir hale geldi.
🧬 2025 - GPT-5 (Akıl Yürütme / Reasoning)
OpenAI’ın o meşhur "Düşünen Yapay Zeka" (o1/o3) devrimi. Sistem artık soruyu görür görmez refleks olarak cevap vermiyor; "Akıl Yürütme Jetonları" (Reasoning Tokens) harcayarak arka planda derinlemesine düşünüyor, strateji kuruyor ve hata payını sıfıra indiriyor. ChatGPT içerisindeki akıllı yönlendiriciler (router) sistemin beyni oldu.
🌐 2026 - GPT-6 (Asenkron ve Otonom Araçlar)
Ve bugün ulaştığımız son nokta... GPT-6 artık sadece bir sohbet botu değil; sizin yerinize arka planda saatlerce çalışan, kod yazan, analiz yapan "Asenkron Araçlar" kullanıyor. 1.05 Milyon bağlam penceresiyle koca bir kütüphaneyi hafızasında tutuyor, "tur ortası yönlendirme" ile konuşma esnasında kendi hatalarını anlık düzeltiyor ve tamamen aranabilir kişisel notlar tutuyor.
💡 ÖZETLE: Yapay zeka artık "cümle kuran bir çocuk" aşamasından, "sizin yerinize şirket yönetebilecek otonom bir iş ortağı" seviyesine ulaştı.
Sizce bu hızla gidersek önümüzdeki birkaç yıl içinde yapay zeka iş dünyasını nasıl şekillendirecek? Bilgileri kaybetmemek için yer işaretlerine eklemeyi unutmayın, yorumlarda tartışalım! 👇

Công nghệ thông tin là ngành học thu hút nhiều học sinh nhờ cơ hội làm việc trong các lĩnh vực như phát triển phần mềm, trí tuệ nhn tạo, dữ liệu và an toàn thông tin. Tuy nhiên, khi thị trường tuyển dụng ngày càng cạnh tranh, không ít học sinh băn khoăn Công nghệ thông tin có dễ xin việc không, liệu học CNTT có thất nghiệp không và mức lương khi mới ra trường như thế nào? items.title: Australia considers criminal penalties for rogue AI in wake of OpenAI hack
items.summary:
In September, Australia's Prime Minister Anthony Albanese revealed that a rogue OpenAI agent had "infiltrated" a government health website and other systems, and criticised the company for taking months to tell them about the hack.

On Tuesday, he released the 18 recommendations made after a "rapid review" into the breaches including new safety and security standards for AI companies such as mandatory reporting of hacks. [...] # Australia considers criminal penalties for rogue AI in wake of OpenAI hack

Getty An older man with grey hair and glasses wearing a suit and tie raises a hand as he speaks in parliament

Australia plans to create a new AI safety regulator and has flagged criminal penalties for tech companies who do not comply, months after an OpenAI hack. [...] It took several more days before the email was escalated to Australia's cybersecurity centre, with a message then sent to a government minister ahead of the prime minister being told.

Albanese said he spoke to OpenAI boss Sam Altman and raised "Australia's extreme concern about this incident" and with Altman acknowledging there were "issues with protocols" at OpenAI.

Days after the hacks were revealed, OpenAI delayed its rollout of a new AI model, citing safety concerns.

items.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5: Accelerating Physical Intelligence — Google DeepMind
items.summary: Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2.5, our most capable vision-language-action (VLA) model to date. Gemini Robotics 2.5 increases both the breadth of skills a robot can learn and the speed at which it can acquire them. This enhances dexterity, reliability, and safety to help robots step out of the lab and into more unstructured, real-world environments, where they can assist people with a greater range of tasks. [...] Using our embodied reasoning model (Gemini Robotics ER) to keep track of the workflow, and the Gemini Robotics 2.5 actions model to control its hands and arms, the robot reaches into supply bins, picks up metal automotive brackets, and places them into sequencing containers, all while correcting for any gaps. Achieving a 96% success rate, this pilot shows promising progress toward widespread real-world industrial applications. [...] Gemini Robotics 2.5 uses inference-time reasoning guidance to steer around physical hazards in real-time. Much like safety classifiers add a protective layer around Gemini’s responses, this guidance allows the robot to navigate complex environments securely. In our evaluations, this capability boosted safe task completion around obstacles by 33% and around nearby people by 43%.

Path Robotics co-founders and brothers Andy and Alex Lonsberry (Photo: Path Robotics)

  

Columbus-based Path Robotics has raised $300 million in Series E financing at a $2.45 billion post-money valuation to expand its robotic welding business and bring its artificial intelligence technology to more manufacturing tasks. [...] Path’s expansion targets a production challenge: manufacturers with demand for more products but limited capacity to build them.

The company develops physical AI—technology that enables robots to perceive their surroundings and adapt their actions to changing conditions. Its initial focus has been welding, where variations in parts and joints can make conventional, preprogrammed automation difficult to deploy.

items.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
items.summary:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

items.title: OpenAI’s Plan to Stop AI Data Centres Overloading the Grid | Energy Digital
items.summary:
A vocal section of the American electorate were seeking assurances that AI companies will not overload power grids, while many candidates ran on a ticket of holding hyperscalers to account.

Before a single vote was counted, though, OpenAI, the company behind ChatGPT, had unveiled its ‘Grid Protectors Program’ – an initiative that will see its future computing campuses ease pressure on the grid. [...] “Data centres are paying more so families and small businesses can pay less, and our goal with every contract we sign under this framework is to deliver value for them,” she says

At OpenAI, the bigger picture is always in focus.

“With US data centre capacity projected to exceed 100 gigawatts by 2030⁠, we have a once-in-a-generation opportunity to strengthen the electric grid by building campuses that can adjust their power use when communities need it most,” the company says. [...] OpenAI is working to ensure its data centres can actually benefit grids, rather than overloading them. Credit: Anna Moneymaker/Getty

## What is OpenAI’s Grid Protectors Program?

The programme, which was announced on 2 November, commits the company to working with utilities, regulators and policymakers on arrangements for cutting the power use of its data centres at times of need.
